summary: Participants weigh the benefits of requiring Java 25, noting limited maintenance gains and unclear performance improvements, and ultimately agree to adopt Dongjoon's proposal. This SPIP extends push-down to include missing join types, set operations, and window functions, allowing the source to decline any push and have Spark execute locally if needed. Participants raise concerns about capacity limits, budget constraints, and the potential negative impact on committers’ productivity, while also considering alternatives such as pre-merge CI against the latest master or a merge queue. The proposal introduces an on-demand lookup join that streams data can use to retrieve matching records from external storage, avoiding full static side loads.
